description: 48x 100M/1/10/25G SFP28 and 6x 10/25/40/50/100G QSFP28 1RU data-centre leaf switch running NX-OS. The port side carries all fifty-four ports, two coaxial timing jacks, a GNSS antenna jack and six lamps. The other side carries two power supplies, four fan modules, the console, the management port, a ToD jack and the USB port. Ports number 1-54 and run DOWN each column, odd on the top row. Ships port-side intake (burgundy modules) or port-side exhaust (blue).

gaps.note: The FX3 guide and the FX3S guide print the same three figures (art numbers 502822, 502823, 502824), and the FX3 guide's overview opens "The Cisco N9K-C93180YC-FX3, N9K-C93180YC-FX3H switch". Neither guide says that a model lacks a jack the figure draws.
gaps.wanted: Whether the 1PPS, 10MHz, GNSS antenna and ToD jacks and the three timing lamps are on every model the guides name or on the H model only. The face carries them because the guides' only figure does; a photograph of a plain FX3 would settle it.

gaps.note: Appendix C names SYNC, TIMING, GNSS and GPS lamps. The figure draws six square lamps under the left of the SFP block and prints a legend under each that is a few pixels high.
gaps.wanted: The six legends as printed, and whether the last reads GNSS or GPS. They are drawn as BCN, STS, ENV, SYNC, TIMING and GNSS.

gaps.note: The FX3 guide's Altitude Requirements say "Altitude rating is 10,000 ft (3048 m). For China, it is 6,562 ft (2000 m)." Its Environmental Specifications table says operating "0 to 13,123 feet (0 to 4,000 meters)". Same measure, same scope, same guide.
gaps.wanted: Which is the rating. The table's figure is carried in the attrs, as the 93180YC-EX's was.

gaps.note: The guide's overview names the N9K-C93180YC-FX3H beside the FX3, but its dimension, weights and power tables name the N93180YC-FX3 only.
gaps.wanted: A dimension, weight and power row for the N93180YC-FX3H. The FX3H configurations carry the FX3 row, and that row is an estimate for them.

gaps.note: The guide's Installing the Airflow Sleeve says the sleeve "is only compatible with rack mount kit (N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT)". Its Airflow Sleeve table (page 28, PDF page 34) lists the N9K-C93180YC-FX3, 672.49 to 784.25 mm, and does not name the FX3H. Its installation options list NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU alone, and no guide gives the contents of the N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT.
gaps.wanted: What the N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT holds, and whether it is a kit this switch is sold with. It is not listed.

A drawing of the lid, the underside and the two side walls. The guide's overview shows one side wall in three-quarter view and calls out its mounting-bracket screw holes and a grounding pad; none is flat and none can be measured. Each face carries an `empty:` sentence.

gaps.note: The guide's weights table gives 2.42 lb (1.1 kg) against the 650 W AC supply and has no row for the 1200 W HVAC/HVDC or the 930 W DC supply. No weight is carried for either.
gaps.wanted: The weight of the N9K-PUV-1200W and the NXA-PDC-930W, from a document that prints it.

A picture of the 930 W DC and the 1200 W HVAC/HVDC supply. The guide's figures show AC supplies only, and its replacement chapter has no picture. Their faces are the AC supply's with the inlet changed.
A stated size for the supply and the fan module. The guide gives "Form factor RSP1" for every supply and nothing for the fan.

attrs.redundancy-note: Installation guide, Overview: four fan modules of two rotors each. The guide says the switch "runs with +1 redundancy mode" and does not sustain a second failed fan. It works with one rotor failed in any one module and, with more than one rotor failed, warns and powers down in two minutes.

mgmt.mixed: the out-of-band block between the fan modules and supply 2: an RJ-45 console port, an RJ-45 management port and a USB port. Three media, one purpose: reaching the switch when the data plane cannot.

attrs.redundancy-note: installation guide: "Power supply modules (two-One for operations and one for redundancy [1+1])". Slot 1 is on the left and slot 2 on the right.

timing.mixed: the precision-timing jacks: two SMB coax jacks for the 1PPS and 10MHz signals, an SMA jack for the GNSS antenna and, on the other side, a ToD RJ-45. Two media, one job: giving the switch a time and frequency reference.

name: n9k-c93180yc-fx3

colour.note: NO SOURCE FOR THE COLOUR. The guides' figures are uncoloured line art. #d0d2cf is the value the 93180YC-EX's stencil sample gave, carried across as a family colour; it is a relative's figure and not a reading of this device.

front-lamps.note: Six square lamps stand in a row under the left of the SFP block, at 19.3, 28.1, 34.1, 42.5, 48.5 and 56.9 mm and 39.3 mm down, each with a printed legend under it that the figure cannot resolve. THEIR NAMES ARE INFERRED: the guide's LED appendix lists BCN, STS and ENV, "located on the left side of the front", then SYNC, TIMING, GNSS and GPS; the legends' widths in the figure fit BCN, STS, ENV, SYNC, TIMING and a four-letter name, in that order, and the sixth is drawn as GNSS. Whether it is GNSS or GPS, and whether the timing lamps exist on a switch that is not the FX3H, are in the gaps.

front-left-block.note: The figure's callout 1 is "1PPS and 10MHz SMB ports", callout 2 "GPS/GNSS antenna connector, ANT port is SMA Pin In" and callout 3 the lamps. Two round jacks and a larger one stand in a column at the left, centred 9.1 mm from the fold line and 11.1, 20.4 and 29.9 mm down; the two upper ones are drawn as std/smb@1 and the lower as std/sma@1 because the guide names the types. A printed legend sits under each: 1PPS, 10MHz, ANT. THE FIGURE'S LEGENDS ARE A FEW PIXELS HIGH. "1PPS" and "ANT" read; the second reads like 10MHZ and is spelled as the guide spells it, 10MHz.

gate-1.note: The front figure's body, between its two fold lines, is 1251 px across and 124 px down (the outer outline is 1260 across): aspect 10.09 against the guide's 17.3 x 1.72 in, 10.05, so 0.4% out, and it can be measured. 2.847 px per mm across, from 439.4 mm. The rear figure's body is 1257 px across and 126 down, 9.98, 0.7% out the other way, 2.861 px per mm across and 2.883 down. A repeated feature checks the scale: the SFP columns step 40.96 px, 14.39 mm, against the registry's 14.25 (1.0% out), and the two groups of twelve end 6 and 5 px short of the body's two fold lines.

interface-names.note: mgmt0 is stated: the guide's setup chapter asks for "the Management (Mgmt0) interface". Ethernet1/1 to Ethernet1/54 are NOT IN ANY GUIDE HELD (searched all three for "Ethernet1/": none) and the NetBox device-type file, which names them, is not held, only its path. They are the slot/port form NX-OS uses on the fixed Nexus 9300 and are not written into the device: the faceplate prints 1 to 54.

port-lamps.note: Appendix C, Switch Chassis LEDs: "The port LEDs appear as triangles pointing up or down to the nearest port." Each port lamp is green (admin up, module present, link up), amber (admin down or module absent) or off (up and present but no link). The figure draws an up and a down triangle in each SFP column's lamp band and one at each end of each QSFP28 band, with four small windows between them. The windows are drawn as marks and carry no state; the guide does not name them.

port-order.note: The figure prints a pair of numerals over each column of cages, "1 up down 2" and so on to "47 up down 48", and "49 up down 50", "51 ..." and "53 ..." over the QSFP28 pairs, so the odd port is the upper cage. The numerals are blurred at this size; the order is the one the guide's own text gives (ports 1-48 and 49-54) and the printed pattern the 93180YC-EX shows, which is a relative and is not evidence. Port numbers are as printed; the NX-OS interface names are in the interface-names entry.

power.note: Appendix B, Switch Power Input Requirements: typical 375 and maximum 600 W "(AC or DC)", 2047.285 BTU per hour, the same in the FX3S guide. The guide says "375" with no unit and the maximum as "600W". The figures are the switch's draw and not a supply rating; neither guide names the configuration or ambient.

rack-ears.note: The guide's rack-mounting figure (art number 503557, PDF page 31) draws the NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU front bracket screwed to the chassis side twice, once on the drawing of the port end and once on the drawing of the module end, with the bracket at a different place on the side in each. The text says the holes used depend on the rack and on the clearance needed for interface cables, 3 inches minimum, and for module handles, 1 inch minimum (it prints the metric as 7.6 mm and 2.5 mm, which are centimetres). Those are clearances and not setbacks. The figure dimensions neither place and the guide does not say which the box ships with, so the two positions are written without an `at`, named for what the text says they clear, and none is the default.

rear-face.note: Every x and y on the power-supply side is read off the rear figure (2.861 px per mm across, 2.883 down) and is estimated. The figure shows supply 1, four fan modules, then the console jack over the management jack, a recessed box holding the ToD jack over the USB port, and supply 2: THE OUT-OF-BAND BLOCK SITS BETWEEN THE FANS AND SUPPLY 2, not beyond supply 2 as on the 93180YC-EX. The figure labels nothing beside the supplies, so the P1, F1 and similar strips of the EX are not drawn. Two lamps with a screw between them stand below the jacks.

rear-lamps.note: The two rear lamps sit 306.5 and 318.9 mm across and 37.7 mm down, with a screw between. The guide says of the front lamps, "The function is the same for the port and rear side of switch". Their legends are BCN and STS, which the 93108TC-FX3 guide's rear figure prints legibly; this guide's figure shows two short legends it cannot resolve.

sources.note: Three guides, held as PDF and as converted text and figures; none is committed. (1) Cisco N93180YC-FX3 NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, First Published 2021-02-16, Last Modified 2026-07-27, 68 pages: the overview and its two figures (art numbers 502822, 502823 and 502824), appendix B specifications, appendix C LEDs, appendix D kits. (2) Cisco N93180YC-FX3S NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, First Published 2020-07-22, Last Modified 2026-07-27, 72 pages: the same text and the same three figures. NO DATA SHEET, PHOTOGRAPH, 3D MODEL OR STENCIL IS HELD for this model, and the NetBox devicetype-library is held as a path listing only: it names the device type and a front and a rear elevation for this model, and neither file was read. THE GUIDE'S FIGURES ARE FLAT AND CARRY CALLOUTS: the front is 715 px native across the body, about 1.6 px per mm, so every position here is a reading good to about a millimetre.

stack-orientation.note: The library's convention: the upper cage upright over the lower turned 180. THE FIGURE CANNOT CONFIRM IT. Its cages are drawn as front faces with the module block shaded, and the lamp band between the rows prints an up triangle toward the upper cage and a down triangle toward the lower, which is the arrangement the convention gives. The same reading holds for the three QSFP28 pairs.

the-width.note: Both guides' Switch Dimensions table: "17.3 inches (43.9 cm)" wide, "19.5 inches (49.6 cm)" deep and "1.72 inches (4.4 cm) (1 RU)" high, the same in the FX3 and FX3S guides. 439.4 mm, 495.3 mm and 43.7 mm are carried (the inch figures converted; the centimetre figures are rounded). The FX3 guide's table lists the N93180YC-FX3 only: THE FX3H, which its overview names, has no row, and is given this row, estimated. The guide's rack clearance figure gives the width with two rack-mount brackets as 19.0 in (48.3 cm).

the-x-axis.note: From the front figure at 2.847 px per mm, origin the body's left fold line. The two groups of twelve SFP columns are centred at 101.9 and 277.9 mm; at the registry's 14.25 mm pitch they start at 16.4 and 192.4, with a 5.0 mm gutter. The figure's own outlines give 14.39 mm and a 3.3 gutter; the registry's pitch is used because a cage's pitch is a standard, and the group centres are what the figure fixes. The three QSFP28 cages start at 366.9, 389.8 and 412.7: their 22.9 mm step is the figure's, 65 px, and is NOT the 24.4 mm of the 93180YC-EX. Their right edge, 432.7, is the figure's.

the-y-axis.note: From the same figure, origin the top fold line, 2.847 px per mm. The SFP cage block runs from 10.7 to 35.8 mm; two openings of the registry's 10.4 on the registry's 15.0 row pitch fill 10.5 to 35.9, so 15.0 is used. The 93180YC-EX carries 16.2 for the same cage and the figure does not support it. The QSFP28 pairs, 10.15 high, run 10.6 to 35.75 on the same 15.0. The lamp band reads 20.9 to 25.5 mm between the SFP rows.
